_comment: Pipeline reads only 'values'. 9 models validated and enabled. Completed Datasets skip already-run+uploaded results (BiMMuDa validated for MT3/Omnizart/Jointist/CREPE; piano models + ReconVAT completed earlier). Basic Pitch has completed=[] (its -i/-o wrapper was just fixed, so it re-runs including BiMMuDa). MR-MT3 is disabled/deferred: its env is buildable (torch 2.1.0+cu121 / TF 2.13, segfault fixed) but the seqio/t5 stack (tensorflow_metadata/tfds/protobuf) still conflicts; its sibling MT3 already works. CREPE is a monophonic pitch tracker so its scores on polyphonic data are near-zero by design.
